description.value: You can use @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-feats.Item.XZVqls0kVg0uxOxP]{Prismatic Reflect} against magic. When you do, the trigger becomes "you become the target of a spell". In addition to the bonus to AC, Prismatic Reflect grants you a +2 status bonus to your saving throw against the triggering spell. If the triggering spell misses, or you roll a Success or Critical Success on your saving throw against the triggering spell, make a spell attack roll against the triggering caster. On a hit, the target takes @Damage[10d6[untyped]] damage of one of the same types as the triggering spell (double damage on a critical hit). If the triggering spell doesn't deal a type of damage, this deals force damage instead.
